title: What to Wear for a Berlin Walking Tour - Quick Summary
items: **Start with supportive shoes.** Berlin's central walking routes use hard pavement and include long pauses, so comfort and grip matter more than a perfect photograph.
**Use removable layers.** A breathable base, a light outer layer and a compact rain option handle the move between open streets, shade, transport and indoor stops.
**Dress for the route shape.** Alexanderplatz and Museum Island need reliable city shoes, the Großer Tiergarten rewards a stable sole, and a neighbourhood evening needs a layer after sunset.
**Keep the bag small.** Carry water, one useful layer and the rain solution you actually need; do not carry a second wardrobe.
Use the Berlin Walking Kit to assemble a practical wear, carry and leave arrangement before you start your walk.
